title: Microsoft Purview Classification
description: Represents a classification (tag) applied to data entities in Microsoft Purview. Classifications are used for data sensitivity labeling and categorization.

attributes.description: The attributes of the classification instance

typeName.description: The name of the classification type (e.g., MICROSOFT.PERSONAL.NAME, MICROSOFT.FINANCIAL.CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER)

entityGuid.description: The GUID of the entity this classification is applied to

entityStatus.description: The status of the associated entity

propagate.description: Whether the classification propagates to child entities

removePropagationsOnEntityDelete.description: Whether propagated classifications are removed when the source entity is deleted

validityPeriods.description: Time-bounded validity periods for the classification

endTime.description: The end time of the validity period

startTime.description: The start time of the validity period
